packageRules.description: Robolectric's runtimes follow the robolectric release that expects them, and the API 26 one must stay on Android 8.0; a robolectric bump updates them by hand.
media3-ffmpeg-decoder and ass-media are built against one Media3 release, so a Media3 bump waits for the matching media3-ffmpeg-decoder and ass-media; playbackNotices follows by hand.
